name: Annis (Paragon Hag Family)
body:
The annis hags are massive hags with iron claws and a penchant for spreading misery. Their family is the most dangerous in melee combat.

Family Spells: enlarge person (can be cast on monstrous humanoids) (3rd), fog cloud (6th), greater magic fang (9th), stoneskin (12th), righteous might (15th), mass bull’s strength (18th).
Ritual Spells – Survival: mass enlarge person (can be cast on monstrous humanoids) (5th), spell resistance (7th), move earth (9th), giant form I (11th), polymorph any object (13th), extended giant form II (15th), extended shapechange (17th), sympathetic* imprisonment (19th).
Family Powers: Annis paragon hags’ limbs and claws grow long and strong.
Iron Muscles (Ex)

At 1st level, when unarmored and unencumbered, you add your Charisma bonus (if any) to your AC and CMD.

Savor Misery (Ex)

At 4th level, you may spend a soul point as a swift action to designate a target for misery. Until you designate a new target, apply your Charisma bonus on all attack rolls against the target and you may choose to deal nonlethal damage to them at no penalty.

Rending Claws (Ex)

At 8th level, you gain the rend monster ability. If you hit with two or more claws in 1 round, you can cause tremendous damage by latching onto the opponent’s body and tearing flesh. This attack deals an additional amount of damage, but no more than once per round. The additional damage is equal to the damage caused by your claw attack plus 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus.

Annis Strength: At 12th level, you gain a +2 inherent bonus to Strength. At 16th level, this bonus increases to +4. At 20th level, it increases to +6.

Organ Rend (Ex)

At 16th level you may spend a soul point when you damage a target with rending claws to deal 1 point of Constitution, Dexterity, or Strength bleed damage (your choice). Creatures immune to critical hits or precision damage, such as sneak attacks, are immune to this bleed damage.

Legendary Family

Upon reaching 20th level, your body becomes hard as iron, granting you DC 10/adamantine. Your claws ignore hardness and penetrate DR as adamantine.
